description: This file defines a React component for a login page, handling user input for email and password, login process via HTTP requests, and modal dialogs for password reset functionality.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: A React component handling login UI, form validation, and password reset modals.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state and binds event handler methods.

methods.name: onClickLogin
methods.description: Triggers login attempt after validating credentials.

methods.name: onEmailChanged
methods.description: Updates email state and validation flags.

methods.name: onPasswordChanged
methods.description: Updates password state and validation flags.

methods.name: onPasswordResetClicked
methods.description: Prepares to show the password reset modal.

methods.name: isEmailInvalid
methods.description: Determines if email input is invalid.

methods.name: isPasswordInvalid
methods.description: Determines if password input is invalid.

methods.name: sendLoginRequestIfCredentialsAreValid
methods.description: Calls login request if input validation passes.

methods.name: sendLoginRequest
methods.description: Performs login HTTP request and handles response.

methods.name: renderLoginError
methods.description: Renders login error message if login fails.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders login UI including form fields, buttons, and modals.
